categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the manufacturing of large slewing bearings and precision bearings, including wind power main shaft bearings, yaw bearings, pitch bearings, gearbox bearings, and key components for wind turbines, marine engineering equipment, shield machines, and construction machinery. It also produces industrial forgings, rolling elements, locking plates, and high-speed couplings. Additionally, the company has subsidiaries engaged in forging, rolling element production, photovoltaic power generation, and precision bearing manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies such as bainitic quenching, precision machining, heat treatment, and digital twin modeling for wind power bearings. It integrates high-end CNC equipment, including fully numerical control quenching machines, five-axis machining centers, and ultra-precision grinding machines. The company also develops proprietary welding and forging processes, bearing design innovations, and intelligent embedded sensor technologies to enhance product performance and reliability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global leading wind turbine manufacturers, large machinery groups, and major state-owned enterprises. The company serves industries such as wind power generation, marine engineering, shield tunneling, and construction machinery. Its products are widely used in onshore and offshore wind turbines, marine cranes, shield machines, and engineering equipment, with a strong focus on domestic market penetration and increasing export activities.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations and sales are predominantly within China, accounting for over 98% of revenue, with a small but growing international market presence. Its manufacturing and R&D facilities are mainly located in Luoyang, Henan Province, with subsidiaries in Shanghai, Jiangsu, and other regions. The company actively participates in global markets through exports and international cooperation.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and assembly of slewing bearings and precision bearings. It has extended upstream by establishing subsidiaries for forging and rolling element production, thereby integrating key raw material and component supply to enhance cost control and product quality.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing high-end, precision, intelligent, and green bearing technologies aligned with national manufacturing and clean energy policies. The company emphasizes R&D in large-capacity wind turbine bearings, offshore wind power components, and marine engineering bearings. It invests in digital twin modeling, sensor integration, and innovative manufacturing processes to improve product lifespan, reliability, and performance while promoting domestic substitution of imported products.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized bearing products and related components to industrial clients, including wind turbine manufacturers and equipment makers. The company also earns income from photovoltaic power generation and investment returns. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales channels, with contracts secured through bidding and negotiation, and pricing based on market conditions and customer agreements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position domestically in large slewing bearings and wind power bearings, competing with both international and domestic bearing manufacturers. It has established a competitive edge through comprehensive product lines, advanced technology, and integrated supply chain capabilities. The company is recognized for breaking foreign monopolies in offshore wind and marine equipment bearings and is positioned as a key player in the Chinese high-end bearing market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately 2.95 billion RMB, representing a 4.32% increase from the previous year. However, net profit attributable to shareholders declined by 82.56% to about 65.38 million RMB due to industry price pressures and market fluctuations. Total assets reached 10 billion RMB, with steady growth in production volumes and strategic investments in capacity expansion and R&D. The company maintains a stable but challenging growth trajectory amid competitive market conditions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high precision, reliability, and customization in its bearing products, supported by advanced manufacturing technologies and comprehensive quality control systems. Its integrated industrial chain from forging to rolling elements ensures cost efficiency and product consistency. The company’s focus on innovation, including intelligent bearings with embedded sensors and digital twin technology, differentiates it in the high-end market and supports domestic substitution of imported products, enhancing customer value through performance and service.
